reviews.text: She saved my Felv-positive kitten on more than one occasion. Always available and professional.

Exceptional, two in a million
The veterinarian was excellent, very competent and professional. Her assistant, Grazia, was also very good. We had a small, unexpected mishap with our dog during our vacation. In addition to their expertise, they were both very kind and had the right attitude to make our melodramatic dog feel at ease. No muzzle was needed. Lots of cuddles, lots of patience, confidence in what to do or how to treat her, and a palpable love for our furry friends. If you're going to Naples or are in the area, this is the place to go. Thank you so much.

Excellent veterinarian, very amazing and sensitive. She's excellent at first aid and offering advice in severe cases, like my beloved Arturino.
She has a very good anesthesiologist (Renato) and an excellent assistant.
She has plenty of experience.
I recommend her without hesitation.

She used to be good, but today I can say no more. It might be tiredness. She can't handle too many dogs and cats anymore, and she can easily make mistakes by giving the wrong solutions and treatments. Obviously, I'm speaking from personal experience.
I won't add anything else.
Courtesy, professionalism, experience, and great humanity. Thank you so much, Doctor.
